name: High Executor Darthalia
summary: High Executor Darthalia is a high-ranking Forsaken military commander stationed at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Acting under the direct authority of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, she directs Forsaken operations against the human stronghold of Southshore and local Syndicate brigands. Her leadership is central to securing the Horde's southern flank in Lordaeron.

sections.title: Commander of Tarren Mill
sections.body: Operating out of Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia serves as the operational commander for Forsaken forces throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills. Her primary strategic concern is halting the expansion of human resistance, keeping the Alliance forces in Southshore contained, and hunting down the lawless Syndicate rogues infesting the surrounding countryside. Every offensive push into southern Hillsbrad flows directly through her command.

sections.title: The War for Hillsbrad
sections.body: Under direct orders originating from the Undercity's high leadership—the Banshee Queen and her dreadlord lieutenant, Varimathras—Darthalia oversees the relentless attrition war across Hillsbrad. She coordinates scouting missions, targeted strikes against human leadership, and bounties on dangerous outlaws who threaten the Forsaken hold on northern Lordaeron.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia is a Forsaken military leader stationed in Hillsbrad Foothills. She is responsible for directing Horde and Forsaken military efforts against the human town of Southshore and eliminating hostile regional threats.
She commands Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill, organizing troops and coordinating strikes across the central region of Lordaeron.

Darthalia operates under the direct military hierarchy of the Undercity, answering to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the dreadlord Varimathras as they coordinate the defense and expansion of Forsaken territory.

faq.q: What tasks does Darthalia give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Darthalia tasks Horde champions with striking directly against human settlements, executing dangerous outlaws, and hunting down members of the Syndicate operating throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why is Darthalia fighting the humans of Southshore?
faq.answer: Southshore represents the primary Alliance military foothold in Lordaeron. Darthalia's mission is to suppress the human presence, protect Tarren Mill, and prevent the Alliance from pushing north toward the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Darthalia's rank in the Forsaken military?
faq.answer: As a High Executor, Darthalia holds one of the highest field-grade ranks within the Forsaken military hierarchy, granting her operational command over regional forces, outposts, and war strategy in the zone.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, Darthalia represents the iron will of the Undercity, ensuring that Lordaeron remains firmly in the hands of the free-willed undead.
Horde adventurers report to Darthalia to check Alliance aggression and hold the contested frontier of Hillsbrad Foothills.
To the humans of Southshore and their allies, Darthalia is the ruthless architect behind the relentless assaults threatening their last foothold in Lordaeron.
